title: Out-of-Network Fitting Amounts for Contact-Lens Claims, Vision Plans
content:
**Fitting amount — Vision Plans out-of-network claims settled on the contact-lens part**

The fitting amount follows the claim's lines:

- **100.00** when the claim carries a specialty contact-lens fitting line;
- **30.00** when it carries a standard contact-lens fitting line;
- **no fitting amount (0.00)** when it carries no fitting line.

| Fitting kind on the claim | Amount |
|---|---|
| Specialty | 100.00 |
| Standard | 30.00 |
| None | 0.00 |

*Hypothetical cases.* A member's specialty fitting with a receipt of 136.40 meets 100.00. A standard fitting with a receipt of 24.90 is below the 30.00 amount.
